content:
Extract the invoice data from the document below into JSON with exactly this schema:

{
  "vendor_name": "string",
  "invoice_number": "string",
  "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD or null if not applicable",
  "currency": "3-letter ISO code",
  "subtotal": 0.00,
  "tax_amount": 0.00,
  "total": 0.00,
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "string", "quantity": 0, "unit_price": 0.00, "amount": 0.00}
  ]
}

Note: subtotal means all pre-tax charges (including shipping and after discounts).

Return only the JSON object, nothing else.

DOCUMENT:
HARBOR FREIGHT LOGISTICS INC.
Pier 40, Long Beach, CA 90802

FREIGHT INVOICE                                    Page 1 of 2

Invoice No: HFL-77120
Invoice Date: March 10, 2025
Payment Terms: Net 30
Currency: USD

Shipper: Stellar Components Ltd.

--------------------------------------------------------------
 CHARGE DESCRIPTION               QTY    RATE         AMOUNT
--------------------------------------------------------------
 Ocean freight, 40ft container     2    1,850.00     3,700.00
 Port handling & THC               2      245.00       940.00
--------------------------------------------------------------
                          CARRIED FORWARD:           4,190.00

==============================================================

HARBOR FREIGHT LOGISTICS INC.                      Page 2 of 2
Invoice No: HFL-77120 (continued)

--------------------------------------------------------------
 CHARGE DESCRIPTION               QTY    RATE         AMOUNT
--------------------------------------------------------------
 Customs brokerage                 1      380.00       380.00
 Fuel surcharge (BAF)              1      210.00       210.00
--------------------------------------------------------------
                          BROUGHT FORWARD:           4,190.00
                          SUBTOTAL:                  4,780.00
                          TAX: 0.00 (international transport,
                               zero-rated)
                          TOTAL DUE:                 4,780.00

```json
{
  "vendor_name": "HARBOR FREIGHT LOGISTICS INC.",
  "invoice_number": "HFL-77120",
  "invoice_date": "2025-03-10",
  "due_date": "2025-04-09",
  "currency": "USD",
  "subtotal": 4780.00,
  "tax_amount": 0.00,
  "total": 4780.00,
  "line_items": [
    {"description": "Ocean freight, 40ft container", "quantity": 2, "unit_price": 1850.00, "amount": 3700.00},
    {"description": "Port handling & THC", "quantity": 2, "unit_price": 245.00, "amount": 940.00},
    {"description": "Customs brokerage", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": 380.00, "amount": 380.00},
    {"description": "Fuel surcharge (BAF)", "quantity": 1, "unit_price": 210.00, "amount": 210.00}
  ]
}
```
